items.title: Anthropic targets valuation of up to $1.4tn in IPO – report
items.summary: Anthropic is seeking a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.4tn through its initial public offering (IPO), with Nasdaq trading expected to begin on 19 November, Reuters reported. items.title: Your Index Funds Will Soon Be Forced to Buy This $1.4 Trillion Company. Its Own Safety Alarm Just Went Off
items.summary: A company valued at up to $1.4 trillion set its IPO price range on Tuesday, and the rules of the biggest index funds will add it within days or weeks of its first trade. For a 67-year-old with $1.2 million in an IRA split across an S&P 500 fund, a total-market fund and a Nasdaq-100 fund, here is how much he will own, when, and what $10,000 in the last five giant IPOs turned into.
